# specs

> A small method for keeping software honest with coding agents: a living
> specification, testable requirements that cite it, and tests that cite the
> requirements.

If you are a coding agent asked to install specs, follow [install.md](install.md).
Do not copy the method into the repository you are working in.

## Install

- [Install](install.md): install the plugin, then adopt the method with specs-init

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/justinmchase/specs): plugin, skills, audit, and specification
- [Method](https://github.com/justinmchase/specs/tree/v1/.agents/specifications): the normative chapters
- [specs-init](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justinmchase/specs/v1/skills/specs-init/SKILL.md): adopt the method in a repository
- [specs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justinmchase/specs/v1/skills/specs/SKILL.md): write specification chapters
- [requirements](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justinmchase/specs/v1/skills/requirements/SKILL.md): write requirements and trace tests
- [specs-audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justinmchase/specs/v1/skills/specs-audit/SKILL.md): check traceability
